license.privacyBody:
The demo hosted at roy.bz may store account and application data for authenticated users when cloud features are enabled. Guest use and test mode remain local to the browser on that device, and guest/test mode does not perform remote LLM calls or remote writes.

When LLM Resident features are enabled in authenticated cloud mode, provider credentials are handled in a liability-minimizing posture: credential references (provider, alias, status) may be persisted, while secret key material is session-scoped on the client by default and not stored as plaintext in cloud records. You are fully responsible for credentials, secrets, prompts, model outputs, and any actions taken using your accounts or keys.

No warranty or guarantee: Operator App and its author make best-effort security improvements, but security, availability, correctness, and data integrity cannot be guaranteed.

Limitation of liability: to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Operator App and its author are not liable, shall not be held liable, and cannot be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special, punitive, or other damages, losses, claims, costs, or liabilities of any kind arising from or related to the app, its code, integrations, credentials/secrets handling, third-party services, model behavior, user actions, data loss, data corruption, outages, or unauthorized access.

The app is not intended to use analytics or advertising cookies. Authentication/session behavior may involve strictly necessary browser or provider-managed storage.

This demo uses external services (for example, public currency conversion APIs, cloud hosting, authentication providers, and optional LLM providers) that are subject to their own privacy policies and availability.

Navigator bookmarks may include links to third-party websites for demonstration purposes only. Operator App and its author are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or owners of those external sites, their trademarks, or their content. Access and use of third-party sites are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
